_doc: Long Calendar v2b — single-condition VRP<0 gate, drops the CI requirement. May 6 2026. The May 6 173-day smoke of LC v2 (CI≥61.8 AND VRP<0) fired only 17 entries with -₹1,707 train+val PnL — CI was the binding constraint. v2b relaxes by removing the CI condition; long calendar's back-leg vega exposure on a ~21-day differential dominates over front-leg theta, so 'spot near strike' is enforced by max_underlying_move_pct (1.5%) rather than a regime gate. All other params identical to v2.
